name: short-1
system: You are a precise code reviewer. Given a small snippet you make one minimal, correct edit and show it as a unified diff. Be terse: the diff plus at most three sentences.

add.content: Now make `frame_limit()` constexpr-correct and explain in two sentences why the change is or is not a behavior change.
Give the smallest unit test that pins `frames()` and the new accessor on an empty pool, as a diff plus two sentences.
Name one boundary case your test does not cover, in two sentences, then stop.
